review_notes: I read the whole 36-line file. It has two instances, `Preadditive (Ind C)` (built with `Preadditive.ofFullyFaithful`) and `HasFiniteBiproducts (Ind C)`. It has no simp lemmas, no simp attributes, no `@[simp]` definitions and no rewrite rules. It therefore adds nothing that could loop, compete with other rules, expand unwantedly or point the wrong way. I did not search for downstream uses that would need a canonical simp lemma, such as how `Ind.yoneda` interacts with addition. I found no evidence in the file that such a lemma is missing, and I did not want to suggest simp annotations just because an identity looks simple.
